entries.source: The Shade's colossal will keeps it anchored to this world, now as a vengeful, insane spirit.
entries.target: 暗影骷髅强大的意志使它滞留于这个世界，如今它化作了一个充满复仇欲的疯狂灵魂。

entries.source: Did you hear? Something seems to have devoured all the last sandworms!
entries.target: 你听说了吗？似乎有什么东西把剩下的沙虫全都吞噬了！

entries.source:
The heart of the Sandworm Queen, ripped from her dead body.
You could ... consume it, should you feel mad enough or you could try to corrupt it somewhere.
entries.target:
从沙虫女皇尸体上割下的心脏。
如果你足够疯狂，可以……吃下它；或者，你也可以试着找个地方腐化它。

entries.source: #00FF00#You gain an affinity for nature. You can now learn new Harmony talents (press p).
entries.target: #00FF00#你获得了与自然的紧密联系，现在你可以学习新的自然协调系技能（按 P 键）。

entries.source:
One of the ruby eyes of the legendary giant golem Atamathon.
It is said it was made by the halflings during the Age of Pyre as a weapon against the orcs. Even though it was destroyed it managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader, Garkul the Devourer.
entries.target:
传奇巨型傀儡阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛之一。
据说阿塔玛森是半身人在烈火纪为了对抗兽人所造的武器。这具傀儡虽然最终被毁，但还是成功杀死了兽人首领吞噬者加库尔，给兽人以重创。

entries.source: A formation of purple crystal. It seems strangely aware.
entries.target: 一团紫色结晶。它似乎有着奇特的意识。
并将其蒸发成虚无

entries.source: I heard that some old crystals are nearly alive now in the scintillating caves.
entries.target: 我听说闪光洞穴里的一些古老水晶几乎活了过来。

entries.source: A formation of purple crystal, but where the others could only be described as polyhedral, this construct seems to strangely resemble... you, if you were much, much larger.
entries.target: 一团紫色结晶。其他结晶只能用多面体来形容，而这个构造体却奇异地像……你，只不过要大上许多许多。

entries.target: 一只穿着黑色长袍的老兽人。看起来他就是阴影的缔造者。

entries.target: 随着你的阴影死去，保护出口楼梯的魔法护罩消失了。

entries.source: #GREY#The #Source# looks deep into your eyes. You feel torn apart!
entries.target: #GREY##Source#凝视着你的眼睛。你感觉你被撕裂了！
啊呃……咔咔……呜呃……！
为了维网！去死吧，邪教徒！

entries.source: #PURPLE#The #Source# looks afraid, he did not plan on his creation turning against him!
entries.target: #PURPLE##Source#看起来充满了恐惧，他没想到自己的创造竟然背叛了自己！

entries.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They were left behind by the powerful Sher'tul race.
This farportal is not connected to any other portal. It is made for exploration; you cannot know where it will send you.
It should automatically create a portal back, but it might not be near your arrival zone.
entries.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们是由强大的夏·图尔种族留下的。
这道远行传送门没有和其他传送门相连，它是为探索而建造的，你无法知道它会把你送到哪里。
它应该会自动建立一道返程传送门，但那道门未必在你抵达区域的附近。

entries.source: A roughly humanoid creature, with tentacle-like appendages in the place of arms and legs. You gasp in horror as you notice it has no head. Putrid warts form quickly on its skin and explode as quickly.
entries.target: 一只大致呈人形的生物，四肢的位置长着触须般的附肢。当你发现它没有头时，倒吸了一口凉气。腐臭的肉疣在它皮肤上迅速鼓起，又迅速炸开。
并将其慢慢消化

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#As the Weirdling beast falls it shrieks one last time and the door behind it shatters and explodes, revealing the room behind it. The stair up vanishes!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#随着怪诞野兽的倒下，它发出了最后一声尖叫。它身后的门被炸开，里面出现了一个房间，楼梯消失了！

entries.source:
As you enter the familiar Fortress you notice a small orange cat has followed you somehow.
It looks like the kitty you fed earlier.
entries.target:

它看起来就像你不久前喂过的那一只。
